title: nolan — a demo that describes itself
$comment: The self-describing demo. It drives the bundled toy app (examples/site) while the captions narrate nolan's own features and cycle through every caption look. Film in post mode with --style=examples/showcase.style.json so the karaoke and pill highlights animate. This is the flagship 'what can it do' clip.

beats.text: Everything I'm narrating is a caption, composited after filming.
…so a restyle is a re-encode, never a re-shoot.
The beats drive a real app — watch.
Real cursor, real typing, real clicks.
Captions carry meaning. This one is a warning.
Karaoke lights each word as it lands — even in post.
Or a bold pill on the active word.
And nolan verify fails your build when a demo drifts.
One screenplay. Every style. The demo describes itself.
